_meta.notes: Account 9253 is the AcreProfit LLC small-business checking at Points West Community Bank. M77 Ag (Kyle's entity) loans cash into AcreProfit to buy product — these appear as deposits followed by same-day wires to suppliers. NOT all TELEPHONE TRANSFER line items are Kyle loan repayments — some are supplier payments funded by M77 Ag loan-ins. Revised 2026-11-10 after Kyle confirmed the loan-in pattern.

distributionPolicy.rule: NO PARTNER DRAWS until the M77 Ag loan AND the M5 Ag loan are both fully cleared. Every dollar paid to any partner-related entity (M77 Ag, M5 Ag, Kyle personally, Ty personally) is a loan repayment, not a draw.
distributionPolicy.sourceConfirmation: Kyle McConnell 2026-11-10: 'nothing is a partner draw until we clear the loans to M77 ag and M5 Ag'
distributionPolicy.effect: All partner-related outflows YTD are classified as loan repayments. The paymentsToPartners / 'paid to Kyle' / 'paid to Ty' framing is accounting-correctly treated as loan balance paydown, not P&L distribution. Partner K-1 distributions start at $0 until lender balances hit zero.

loanRepaymentsOut.note: Every payment out to a partner-related name is a loan repayment, NOT a draw. Confirmed by Kyle 2026-11-10: 'M77 Ag loans money to acre profit to buy product' / 'same as M5 Ag loans money to acre profit from Ty and then Acre Profit repays M5 AG' / 'nothing is a partner draw until we clear the loans to M77 ag and M5 Ag'. Kyle and Ty's own entities (M77 Ag, ToGo AG, M5 Ag) fund AcreProfit's chemical purchases; AcreProfit repays them as cash comes in from customers. These are NOT P&L items — they're balance-sheet entries against the loans-payable to each lender.
